title: Val
description: As a member of Beckett's crew — and his paramour - Val was a no-nonsense and strong-willed woman and a crack shot with a grapple gun. As the most level-headed member of the crew, the most difficult jobs were often left to her. She was left to blow up a bridge to complete the coaxium heist on Vandor on her own, and with the plan falling apart, she chose to complete the mission by sacrificing herself.
